summary: Verified 5 features across web+mobile as cathy@example.com. AUTH DARK MODE (web): all 5 sub-checks pass — card bg rgb(22,70,72) with clay border-top rgb(181,98,58); Sign in / Create account buttons render clay rgb(165,81,43); Forgot password / Create one / Sign in links render clay rgb(232,160,122); .auth-google-caption present inside data-testid login-google ("Continue with Google") and signup-google ("Sign up with Google"), color cream rgb(244,239,231); selected signup-plan-family and signup-plan-solo cards get clay border+bg (rgb(165,81,43) + rgba(165,81,43,0.20)) — same for signup-role-caregiver. INVOICE PARITY (web): old inv1-draft-all-btn is GONE from both /ai-tools/invoice-checker AND /app/invoices/:id; the standalone "Draft one letter covering all N issues" button (data-testid invoice-detail-draft-all-letter) is present on InvoiceDetail; per-issue "Draft a letter about this" is wired via FlagCard onDraftLetter (data-testid <cardId>-draft-letter) and shown when a flag card is expanded (behaviour matches statement anomaly cards). FEE TRANSPARENCY: decoder-fee-breakdown + decoder-fee-total code paths verified in DecoderResultView.jsx L154-170 and DecoderResultView.tsx L512-525. In this preview fixture set, the seeded statements (blocked + 4 non-blocked tried) do not populate reported_total_gross/care_management/package_management/gst, so FeeBreakdown returns null by design (rows.length<=1 && reported<=0). CONFIDENCE LEGEND: decoder-confidence-legend visible on BOTH blocked and non-blocked statements — web (4 non-blocked + blocked) and mobile (blocked + non-blocked) all rendered the legend. BUTTON RESTYLE: button.jsx uses rounded-lg (not rounded-full) with only hover:bg-* colour changes (no translate/scale/brightness/shadow-lift); landing page and dashboard load cleanly with no broken layout.

InvoiceDetail /app/invoices/457258cf....per-issue-draft: FlagCard.jsx L97-108 renders 'Draft a letter about this' with testId=<id>-draft-letter when card open (matches statement anomaly card pattern)

Matches statement anomaly pattern per spec; parity confirmed. If E1 wants the button always visible on the collapsed card, that would be a separate UX decision.
